name: Page-Image Single-Vector Retrieval
mechanism: Encodes each rendered page image into one vector and retrieves it from a standard approximate nearest-neighbor index.
use_when: A compact visual baseline is needed
Layout or figures matter beyond extracted text
avoid_when: Exact text quotation is the only workload
Page-level pooling loses small relevant regions
expected_effects: Visual candidate retrieval with compact indexing
Coverage of layout and non-text visual cues
